title: Cat Laugh
blurb: A wheezy little feline chuckle, attached to the smug cat faces that have populated the internet since forever. What makes it land is the implied indifference: this is the laugh of something that watched you fail and feels absolutely no obligation to help. Deploy it after fails and bad takes. Also after anyone dropping their phone directly onto their own face. Being laughed at by a cat is measurably more humbling than being laughed at by a person, and the clip endures on that alone.
